lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰੈ ਬਾਗਾ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahirai baagaa kar isanaanaa choaa cha(n)dan laae ||
lines.translation: You wear white clothes and take cleansing baths, and anoint yourself with sandalwood oil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਨਾਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar nahee cheeniaa jiu hasatee naavaae ||3||
lines.translation: But you do not remember the Fearless, Formless Lord - you are like an elephant bathing in the mud. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau hoi kripaal ta satigur melai sabh sukh har ke naae ||
lines.translation: When God becomes merciful, He leads you to meet the True Guru; all peace is in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: mukat bhaiaa ba(n)dhan gur khole jan naanak har gun gaae ||4||14||152||
lines.translation: The Guru has liberated me from bondage; servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||14||152||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਦ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur gur gur sad kareeai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, dwell always upon the Guru, Guru, Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan janam saphal gur keeaa darasan kau balihareeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has made the jewel of this human life prosperous and fruitful. I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete saas graas man letaa tete hee gun gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: As many breaths and morsels as you take, O my mind - so many times, sing His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jau hoi daiaal satigur apunaa taa ih mat budh paaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: When the True Guru becomes merciful, then this wisdom and understanding is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਏ ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man naam lae jam ba(n)dh te chhootahi sarab sukhaa sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, taking the Naam, you shall be released from the bondage of death, and the peace of all peace will be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sev suaamee satigur daataa man ba(n)chhat phal aaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: Serving your Lord and Master, the True Guru, the Great Giver, you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam isat meet sut karataa man sa(n)g tuhaarai chaalai ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Creator is your beloved friend and child; it alone shall go along with you, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar sevaa satigur apune kee gur te paaeeai paalai ||3||
lines.translation: So serve your True Guru, and you shall receive the Name from the Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaal kripaa prabh dhaaree binase sarab a(n)desaa ||
lines.translation: When God, the Merciful Guru, showered His Mercy upon me, all my anxieties were dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh paaiaa har keeratan mitio sagal kalesaa ||4||15||153||
lines.translation: Nanak has found the peace of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. All his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||15||153||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa birale hee kee bujhee he ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The thirst of only a few is quenched. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot jore laakh krore man na hore || parai parai hee kau lujhee he ||1||
lines.translation: People may accumulate hundreds of thousands, millions, tens of millions, and yet the mind is not restrained. They only yearn for more and more. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar naaree anik parakaaree par grih bikaaree || buraa bhalaa nahee sujhee he ||2||
lines.translation: They may have all sorts of beautiful women, but still, they commit adultery in the homes of others. They do not distinguish between good and bad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥ ਮਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anik ba(n)dhan maaiaa bharamat bharamaaiaa gun nidh nahee gaaiaa || man bikhai hee mahi lujhee he ||3||
lines.translation: They wander around lost, trapped in the myriad bonds of Maya; they do not sing the Praises of the Treasure of Virtue. Their minds are engrossed in poison and corruption. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau re kirapaa karai jeevat soee marai saadhasa(n)g maaiaa tarai || naanak so jan dar har sijhee he ||4||1||154||
lines.translation: Those, unto whom the Lord shows His Mercy, remain dead while yet alive. In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they cross over the ocean of Maya. O Nanak, those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||1||154||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਹੂ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhahoo ko ras har ho ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the essence of all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਿਆਨ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਡੰਡ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo jog kaahoo bhog kaahoo giaan kaahoo dhiaan || kaahoo ho da(n)d dhar ho ||1||
lines.translation: Some practice Yoga, some indulge in pleasures; some live in spiritual wisdom, some live in meditation. Some are bearers of the staff. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo jaap kaahoo taap kaahoo poojaa hom nem || kaahoo ho gaun kar ho ||2||
lines.translation: Some chant in meditation, some practice deep, austere meditation; some worship Him in adoration, some practice daily rituals. Some live the life of a wanderer. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: kaahoo teer kaahoo neer kaahoo bed beechaar || naanakaa bhagat pri ho ||3||2||155||
lines.translation: Some live by the shore, some live on the water; some study the Vedas. Nanak loves to worship the Lord. ||3||2||155||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun keerat nidh moree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: To sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is my treasure. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥ ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too(n)hee ras too(n)hee jas too(n)hee roop toohee ra(n)g || aas ot prabh toree ||1||
lines.translation: You are my delight, You are my praise. You are my beauty, You are my love. O God, You are my hope and support. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: toohee maan too(n)hee dhaan toohee pat toohee praan || gur tootee lai joree ||2||
lines.translation: You are my pride, You are my wealth. You are my honor, You are my breath of life. The Guru has repaired that which was broken. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੇਰ ਨੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: toohee grihi toohee ban toohee gaau toohee sun || hai naanak ner neree ||3||3||156||
lines.translation: You are in the household, and You are in the forest. You are in the village, and You are in the wilderness. Nanak: You are near, so very near! ||3||3||156||
